cicdConfiguration.START_PAGE_DESC: This wizard guides you through the initial configuration steps of getting your FortiSOAR environment ready for Continuous Delivery. You can setup this FortiSOAR instance either as a development environment for building new content, or a production environment where the reviewed and unit tested changes are applied, or both.
cicdConfiguration.START_PAGE_DESC1: The wizard also helps you connect your preferred version control system to FortiSOAR.
cicdConfiguration.DEFINE_ENV_PAGE_DESC: To see tasks and workflows relevant to the environment, specify whether the current FortiSOAR instance is a Development or a Production environment.
cicdConfiguration.DEFINE_ENV_PAGE_DESC1: You may select both if you have a single FortiSOAR instance.
cicdConfiguration.SOURCE_CONTROL_DESC: Select a source control platform from the following dropdown to begin the configuration process. Source control helps manage versions and facilitates a continuous integration and deployment process.
cicdConfiguration.SOURCE_CONTROL_DESC1: You can select only one of the available options.
cicdConfiguration.FINISH_PAGE_NAVIGATE2: in the navigation menu to start using this solution.
